question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **process**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Trial**: A test of the performance, qualities, or suitability of someone or something. (परीक्षण)
 
• **Type**: A category of people or things having common characteristics. (प्रकार)
 
• **Method**: The quality of being well organized and systematic in thought or action. (तरीका)
 
• **Process**: A series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end. (प्रक्रिया)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**process**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
